title: Cardi B
description: Supernerd was hired to Art Direct for Cardi B on an ongoing basis. Projects ranged from fashion collection creation, to performance visuals, to website design. Step inside and check out our process on some of these projects.

pieces.title: Bardi Gang Website
pieces.description: For the release of WAP, Cardi's team wanted to create a new website where her fans can sign up for alerts, learn more about Cardi, and actively listen and watch her works. We crafted Cardi world a dimensional pastel surrealist world based on Cardi B's large tattoos of a peacock and tropical florals.

pieces.title: WAP Clothing Line
pieces.description: We were charged to create a collection for Cardi B's upcoming release that would be called WAP. We initially were not give more details than that name and a moodboard that was used to create the music video. The initial collection was to be released through fashion nova, a capsule collection, but due to COVID their staff was too low to get it out in time turning the it from a fashion collection into a merch collection that sold out. Below are both the initial Fashion Nova collection that was made and the merch collection that sold out.

pieces.title: Cardi B Birthday
pieces.description: We were contacted to create the visuals and invite for Cardi's upcoming vegas birthday party. The party was themed for an Arabian Night party. Camels, desert , florals, Arab geometric designs, and luxury finishes in jewel tones. The LED screens wrapped around the entire space over 100 foot long screens.

pieces.title: UP Clothing Line
pieces.description: We were contacted to create a fashion collection for a new upcoming single UP by Cardi B. The moodboards they gave us injected arrows into clothing, inflatables, and clouds. We interpreted this in two directions.

pieces.title: Summer Jam
pieces.description: We crafted the stage visuals for Cardi B's Summer Jam performance. We had a week to make custom visuals for 13 song set.

pieces.title: Cardi B Miami NYE Countdown
pieces.description: We were contacted to craft stage visuals for Cardi B headlining in vegas for New Years Eve celebration dountdown.

pieces.title: Cardi B Vegas
pieces.description: We created simple logo animations for Cardi Vegas performance.

pieces.title: Cardi & Kulture Billboards
pieces.description: We were contacted by Offset to create two billboards for Cari B's birthday to live in Los Angeles

pieces.title: BET Experience
pieces.description: We were created to redo our visuals for Summer Jam and create simple animations around them for her BET experience performance.
